title: OBVIL — corpus d'éditions anciennes françaises (Teinte)
notes: Born-digital TEI corpora of early-modern French texts from LabEx OBVIL (Sorbonne Université), encoded with the Teinte toolchain (lauze_apologie-danse_1623, Faceties 1557, La Bruyère 1694, etc.); CC BY-NC-ND. Org-level attribution: corpus repositories and the Teinte tool live on the OBVIL GitHub org (verified), while the lab's reading sites (obvil.sorbonne-universite.fr, obtic.huma-num.fr) refused connections from two networks at check time. Corpus statistics (text, word and language counts, period) derived from the RQ Open Corpus snapshot v2026.06 (in-core, deduplicated texts).
